data.case_title: Apartment allocation and rental contract (Nutzungsvertrag) for Lindenhof 6
data.title: Housing cooperative allocates apartment and sends Nutzungsvertrag to sign and return
data.summary: Wohnungsgenossenschaft Beispielheim eG has allocated the apartment at Lindenhof 6, 2nd floor left, to Mr. Musterschmidt starting 1 September 2025 and encloses the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) in two copies plus the house rules. He is asked to return one signed copy within 14 working days of the letter's date (4 July 2025).
data.explanation: This letter confirms the housing cooperative has assigned you the apartment at Lindenhof 6 from 1 September 2025 and sends the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) in two copies together with the house rules (Hausordnung). Sign one copy and send it back by the deadline shown in the app, which is counted in working days (Monday to Saturday) from the letter's date. If it does not arrive in time, the cooperative will give the apartment to the next person on the waiting list, so it is important not to delay.
